summary_1line: King Usinara refuses to surrender a pigeon seeking refuge and offers his own flesh to the hawk demanding it as rightful prey.

image_candidates.scene_text: A terrified pigeon clings to King Usinara’s thigh as a hawk confronts him in the royal court demanding its prey.
King Usinara slices flesh from his own body and places it on a balance opposite the small pigeon.
The king climbs onto the scale himself, emaciated and bleeding, as the pigeon still outweighs the flesh.
